The issue being, where my husband is very quiet and withdrawn, I am sociable and outgoing. I was at this point, getting irritated and said "God, I can't stand that loner sometimes". This was heard by my husband who was upset about this statement. After the phone call, he had an angry tone in his voice and said "why won't you just accept me as I am, Gem? Am I that unlikable to you that you need me out of the house or something? I backed off with making complaints about his loneliness and styed quiet as he scolded me for wanting him to change himself. He's been broody ever since this little argument. My sisters got the gist of it in subsequent phone calls and agreed that I shouldn't have been so forceful in wanting him to change. But AITA for just wanting him to be more social?
